summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (41 passed). Not verified: mypy and black were not run because neither is installed in the shared venv. Deviation: an explicit Node isinstance guard was added so None and plain strings cannot act as graph wildcards. Nothing was committed.
